caveats: Business-level data only. Ratings and review counts were read from third-party directories (Birdeye, dentistsranked, WebMD, Zocdoc) rather than from the Google Maps panel itself, so counts may lag Google's live numbers.
Scores are comparable across this batch only (mostly solo/small dental and orthodontic practices in one town), not across categories.
Specialty benchmark used for Leizer's review gap: Karlin 947 reviews and Fleer 321 reviews in the same town, both from third-party directories.
data_gaps: Wang Dental Care returned HTTP 403 'Unauthorized' to the browser at both www and non-www, so no phone-width screenshot or in-browser JSON-LD check was possible; that entry relies on fetched raw HTML and page text.

Dr. Fleer Orthodontics also returned HTTP 403 to the fetcher for the home page and robots.txt; the site loaded normally in the browser, but robots.txt was not re-opened there, so its crawler rules are unverified.
robots.txt was not checked for kiddent.com.
The appointment forms embedded by kiddent.com (Wufoo iframe) and AC Dental (Paperform iframe) are cross-origin, so individual field labels could not be inspected.
Google Business Profile completeness (photos, categories, services) could not be verified directly for any business; 'findable' scores rely on review volume, published hours and crawlability instead.
